preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 400, inclusive.
The number of elements in the set is between 4 and 2^16, and is a power of 2.
The target sum of bitwise AND operations is between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output.count == n/2 and all(a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in output))
postconditions.description: The output contains n/2 pairs of elements, with each element appearing exactly once. No element is paired with itself.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or sum(a_i & b_i for a_i, b_i in output) == k
postconditions.description: The sum of the bitwise AND operations over all pairs in the output equals k.
